# HL7 and connector mappings

!!! info "Generated from the code"
    Generated by `scripts/gen_docs.py` — do not edit by hand. Run the script after changing the code.

How CareFlow reads hospital-system messages, from `backend/app/integrations/hl7.py` and `backend/app/integrations/service.py` (`SUPPORTED`, `CONNECTOR_EVENTS`).

## Patient fields read from ADT messages

Found by parsing a sample message with CareFlow's own parser (`app/integrations/hl7.py: patient_fields()`), so this table always matches the code.

| CareFlow field | HL7 position | Value parsed from the sample |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mrn` | PID-3.1 (prefers the repetition typed `MR`) | `PID3MRN` |
| `name` | PID-5 (given, middle, family) | `PID5GIVEN PID5MIDDLE PID5FAMILY` |
| `ward` | PV1-3.1 | `PV131WARD` |
| `bed` | PV1-3.3 (falls back to PV1-3.2 room) | `PV133BED` |
| `attending` | PV1-7 (prefix or `Dr.`, given, family) | `PV176PREFIX PV173GIVEN PV172FAMILY` |
| `payer` | IN1-4.1 | `IN14PAYER` |
| `payer_type` | derived (see payment type rules below) | `cashless` |
| `admitted_at` | PV1-44 (falls back to EVN-2, then MSH-7) | `2026-01-03 03:03:03+00:00` |
| `visit_number` | PV1-19.1 | `PV1191VISIT` |
| `patient_class` | PV1-2.1 | `PV12CLASS` |
| `discharged_at` | PV1-45 | `2026-01-04 04:04:04+00:00` |

## Payment type rules

- **government** if the payer (IN1-4), plan type (IN1-15) or financial class (PV1-20) contains any of: `GOV`, `CGHS`, `PMJAY`, `PM-JAY`, `AYUSHMAN`, `ESIC`, `ECHS`, `STATE SCHEME`
- **cashless** if there is an IN1 segment with a payer and PV1-20 isn't `SELF`, `SP` or `CASH`
- **self_pay** otherwise

## Supported HL7 message types

- `ADT^A01`
- `ADT^A02`
- `ADT^A03`
- `ADT^A04`
- `ADT^A08`
- `OML^O21`
- `ORM^O01`
- `ORU^R01`
- `RDE^O11`
- `RDS^O13`

Any other type is answered with `AR` (rejected).

## JSON connector events

| System (`/api/integrations/{system}/events`) | Event | What it means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tpa` | `preauth_submitted` | Final authorization request submitted to the payer |
| `tpa` | `query_raised` | Payer asked for a document (data.document) |
| `tpa` | `document_available` | A requested document is available for the claim (data.document) |
| `tpa` | `approved` | Payer approved final authorization |
| `tpa` | `denied` | Payer denied (data.reason) |
| `pharmacy` | `order_placed` | Discharge medicines ordered (data.orderedAt, optional) |
| `pharmacy` | `pharmacist_assigned` | Pharmacist assigned (data.pharmacist) |
| `pharmacy` | `dispensed` | Discharge medicines prepared |
| `pharmacy` | `reconciled` | Medication reconciliation completed |
| `lis` | `report_registered` | Lab order/report registered, not final (data.reportId) |
| `lis` | `report_final` | Report final (data.reportId) |
| `lis` | `report_acknowledged` | Ward acknowledged the final report (data.reportId) |
| `lis` | `order_cancelled` | Lab order cancelled (data.reportId) |
| `his` | `admitted` | Admit or update a patient (data: name, ward, bed, attending, payer, payerType, admittedAt) |
| `his` | `transferred` | Patient moved (data.ward, data.bed) |
| `his` | `discharged` | Patient has left the hospital |
| `his` | `bed_status` | Set a bed's status (data.ward, data.bed, data.status) |
